versions.changelog: Add concurrency limit, async context manager, input validation

Initial release of japan-news-mcp

- Fetches Japanese financial and business news headlines from Yahoo News, NHK, Reuters Japan, and Toyo Keizai via public RSS feeds.
- Supports searching news by keyword and limiting results.
- Allows filtering headlines by specific source.
- Includes commands to list all available news sources and test connectivity.
- No API key required; easy installation via pip or uv tool.
